news_event = {
	id = zin_afrit.75
	title = zin_afrit.75.t
	desc = {
		text = zin_afrit.75.desc
		trigger = {
			has_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed
		}
	}
	desc = {
		text = zin_afrit.75.desc1
	}
	picture = GFX_zin_news_generic_war
	major = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_death_told } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_death_told
			zin_afrit_die = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
				var:global.zin_eindil_host = { country_event = { id = zin_eindil.124 } }
			}
			else = {
				random_country = {
					limit = { AND = { has_character = zin_eindil has_global_flag = zin_in_play_eindil } }
					country_event = { id = zin_eindil.124 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = zin_afrit.75.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
